You only need to do this // for models you load from USDZ or .reality files. uv.y = 1.0 - uv.y; auto tex = params.textures(); half3 color = (half3)tex.emissive_color() .sample(textureSampler, uv).rgb; // Multiply the tint and the sampled value from the texture, // and assign the result to the shader's emissive color // property. color *= emissiveColorTint; params.surface().set_emissive_color(color); ```
